title: 第9章 月末测试第10章 你是第一吗我觉得我是
content_zh:
深秋，天气逐渐转凉！
冷风掠过演武场，带起些许尘土和枯叶。
苍龙帮演武场内，一块粗大滚柱深深打入地下！
整根滚柱一人多高，宽约三尺三寸三分宽！
其由槐木制成，常人哪怕刀劈斧凿，也难以撕开坚硬的木块。
但此刻在其表面却凹陷出十几处拳印！
这些拳印深浅不一，大小不同，出自不同人手！
而这便是苍龙帮的月底考教，以拳力猛击滚木！
入境武者，便是淬体境。
奋力一击便可在此槐木上留下三寸拳印。
而苍龙帮的考教，便是除入帮的首月外，往后每月，所砸出的拳印都要比上月至少深上一分！
若是无法做到，则说明不是练功懈怠，便是资质太差。
无需等半年后的考教，连底层帮众都不用当了，直接加入杂役奴仆队伍。
故而，仅仅只是半年的考教，便将帮众分成三等。
无法通过月底考教的沦为杂役奴仆！月银一两！
无法通过半年考教的，成为底层帮众！销去奴籍，月银三两！
在半年内成功入境的，则销去奴籍，成为月银10两起步的正式帮众！
现场人潮汹涌，上百帮众全都聚在滚柱周围，黑压压一片。
在测试过后，所有通过月底考教的帮众都允许回家休沐一日。
但无论是尚未上场的，还是已经测过的，一个个都想看看身边的同僚成绩几何。

毕竟整场测试下来，耗时不过半个时辰。
他们也想看看这月内自己在周围人中的层次！
现场，一位黑底红纹的劲装少年口中猛地吸气，力从地起，以腰背带动手臂。
“哈！！！”
伴随着一声爆喝，脚下泥土被他绣有云纹的靴子踏出轻微鞋印。
少年右臂猛地挥出！全力轰击在眼前木桩之前！
“咚——”
沉闷的爆响从木桩上传开，盖过了场中的窃窃私语！
只见木屑飞溅！
一个崭新的拳印被留在木桩上。
松开手，看着面前轻轻炸裂的凹坑，少年眼底浮现得意。
在他身旁，一个记录个人成绩的帮内杂役高声唱名：
“李熙，入帮34日，入木三分！”
话音未落，四周立刻爆发出压抑不住的惊叹与议论：
content_en:
In late autumn, the weather is getting cooler!
The cold wind blew across the martial arts arena, bringing up some dust and dead leaves.
In the Canglong Gang's martial arts arena, a thick roller penetrated deeply into the ground!
The entire roller is as tall as a person and about three feet three inches wide!
It is made of locust wood, and it is difficult for ordinary people to tear through the hard wood even with a knife and an axe.
But at this moment, there are more than a dozen punch marks dented on its surface!
These fist marks are of different shades, sizes, and are made by different hands!
And this is the Canglong Gang’s end-of-month test, slamming a rolling log with the power of your fists!
Entering the martial arts realm is the body tempering realm.
A single powerful blow can leave a three-inch fist mark on the locust tree.
The test of the Canglong Gang is that except for the first month of joining the gang, every month thereafter, the fist marks produced must be at least one point deeper than the previous month!
If you can't do it, it means you are either slacking off in practice or your qualifications are too poor.
There is no need to wait for the exam in half a year, and there is no need to be a low-level gang member, and you can directly join the team of handymen and slaves.
Therefore, after only half a year of teaching, the gang was divided into three levels.
Those who fail to pass the exam at the end of the month become slaves! One tael of silver per month!
Those who fail to pass the half-year exam will become low-level gang members! Get rid of your slave status and get three taels of silver per month!
Those who successfully enter the country within half a year will have their slave status cancelled, and become official members starting with 10 taels of monthly silver!
There was a huge crowd at the scene, hundreds of people gathered around the roller, and it was a dark atmosphere.
After the test, all members who passed the exam at the end of the month were allowed to go home and take a day off.
But whether they are those who have not yet played or those who have already taken the test, everyone wants to see the results of their colleagues around them.
After all, the entire test took less than half an hour.
They also want to see how they stand among the people around them this month!
At the scene, a young man dressed in black and red stripes took a sharp breath, lifted up from the ground, and moved his arms with his waist.
"Ha!!!"
Accompanied by a loud shout, his cloud-embroidered boots left slight shoe prints in the soil under his feet.
The boy's right arm suddenly swung out! Bombard with all your strength in front of the wooden pile in front of you!
"Dong——"
A dull explosion spread from the wooden piles, drowning out the whispers in the field!
Sawdust flying everywhere!
A brand new fist mark was left on the wooden stake.
He let go of his hand and looked at the gently exploding pit in front of him, with pride in the young man's eyes.
Beside him, a gang boy who recorded personal achievements loudly called out:
"Li Xi, it's been 34 days since he joined the gang, and he's been in trouble for three points!"
Before he finished speaking, irrepressible exclamations and discussions immediately erupted from all around:
